Sources:
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/tree/master/mobilenet
https://storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models/tfjs/mobilenet_v1_0.25_224/model.json

GymTrack bundles the original MobileNet v1 0.25 224 weights for same-origin loading at first photo analysis. The 55 original shards have been concatenated in manifest order into food-model/weights.bin, and their weight specifications retained in one manifest group. Topology and weight values are unchanged. Model files are loaded on demand and cached for offline use when the device permits it. Photos are processed on the device; no remote AI API receives them.

Original model.json SHA-256: d14c680e069d74143e3771c291cf3fd153ee88b6ea9ee44bfaf84e2008ded44e
Concatenated weights.bin SHA-256: eb49857447f6089e7e392f7991f3f4fdce1936efaf83d535f5eb8aaba9538e0b
Weights: 1902176 bytes.

MobileNet is a generic ImageNet image classifier, not a food-specific nutrition model. Suggestions require user confirmation; quantities and nutrition values are not measured from pixels. Any speed shown by GymTrack is measured on the current device, not a claimed iPhone benchmark.
